seo.title: About Us
seo.description: IrisPro is a protection technology company founded in Malaysia, engineered for the intense sun and unique climate of ASEAN. We create high-performance window film solutions that protect people, interiors and building value—every day.

data.heading: Our Story
paragraphs: IrisPro was born from one simple belief:
Protection should be better, longer lasting and made for ASEAN.
We saw a need for window films that truly block harmful UV, reduce heat effectively and stand strong in our hot, humid climate.
Through continuous research, advanced materials and strict quality control, we developed patented technologies that deliver complete protection beyond what ordinary films can do.
Today, IrisPro is trusted by homeowners, businesses, architects and institutions across the region to create cooler, safer and more sustainable environments.

headlineLines: The first window film innovation on the market
data.categorySubtitle: THE FIRST DUAL-PATENT SYSTEM OF ITS KIND ON THE MARKET
bullets: Patented UV+420™ Optical Technology: The first optical construction on the market cutting 100% of UV400 and high-energy visible (HEV) blue light (380–420nm) for complete ocular and skin cellular defense.
6-Layer Hotmelt™ Base Film: Advanced co-extrusion matrix eliminates bubbling, adhesive oxidation, and delamination in intense ASEAN tropical heat.
Multi-Layer Sputter Engineering: Superior infrared solar heat rejection while maintaining maximum natural visible light transmission without GPS/RFID signal interference.
Zero Haze Optical Clarity: Crystal clear vision with zero distortion, glare reduction, and pristine optical transparency for night driving safety.
10-Year Backed Guarantee: Industry-leading warranty protection certified by SIRIM and recipient of the Asia Automotive Award.

data.heading: Our Milestones
data.subhead: A Decade of Breakthrough Protection & Optical Innovation
data.lede: From our beginnings in Malaysia to expanding across ASEAN, explore the key milestones that shaped our patented optical technologies.

steps.title: IrisPro Founded in Malaysia
steps.description: IrisPro was established in Malaysia with a bold vision: engineering superior, longer-lasting window films specifically formulated to master ASEAN’s extreme solar heat and humidity.

steps.title: Pioneered UV+380™ Technology
steps.description: Launched proprietary UV+380 high-performance optical film, setting a new industry benchmark for full-spectrum solar protection beyond standard automotive tints.

steps.title: Introduced 6-Layer Hotmelt™ Base Film
steps.description: Engineered our patented 6-Layer Hotmelt™ co-extrusion technology, permanently solving bubble formation, adhesive hazing, and delamination in tropical climates.

steps.title: Architectural & Commercial Expansion
steps.description: Expanded high-performance solar control solutions into commercial towers, corporate headquarters, and residential developments to reduce building cooling loads.

steps.title: Achieved Official SIRIM Certification
steps.description: Attained national testing certification from SIRIM QAS International, verifying 99.99% UV400 blocking efficacy, thermal rejection, and structural endurance.

steps.title: Awarded Asia Automotive Award – Asia Best Tint Brand
steps.description: Crowned Asia Best Tint Brand at the prestigious Asia Automotive Awards, recognized by regional industry leaders for exceptional optical innovation and warranty trust.

steps.title: Expanding Across ASEAN & Global Horizons
steps.description: Surpassed 1,000,000+ protected vehicles and buildings across ASEAN, advancing next-generation sustainable optical films and expanding international dealer networks.

data.heading: Awards & Recognition
data.lede: Our patented optical technologies and high-tensile film structures are rigorously tested and certified by premier automotive and architectural authorities across ASEAN.

awards.title: Asia Automotive Award
awards.subtitle: Asia Best Tint Brand 2025
awards.description: Awarded the prestigious Asia Best Tint Brand in recognition of IrisPro’s patented optical protection, ASEAN climate durability, and market-leading heat rejection technology.

awards.title: SIRIM QAS Certified
awards.subtitle: National Standards & Quality Compliance
awards.description: Rigorous independent laboratory verification confirming 99.99% UV400 blocking efficacy, visible light transmittance compliance, and thermal aging stability.

awards.title: ARCHIDEX Award
awards.subtitle: Architectural Innovation & Best Product
awards.description: Honored by architects and property developers for significant cooling energy savings, carbon reduction, and zero-haze optical performance in architectural glass.

awards.title: MTPN Consumer Trust
awards.subtitle: National Consumer Action Council Award
awards.description: Recognized for exceptional customer advocacy, transparent product testing, and verified 10-year manufacturer warranty fulfillment across ASEAN.
